source.quote: 人体外推前必须至少有 3 个符合该参数要求的物种。完成可支持的指标；符合条件的参数可以交给外推分支审核，原有缺口继续保留 并不一定要房室模型 允许经审核的人源体外结合／代谢数据作为预测输入

decisions.text: Before human extrapolation, require at least three distinct species qualified for the specific parameter being predicted.
decisions.does_not_block: Supported upstream NCA, data preparation or animal modeling

decisions.text: Complete supported endpoints and submit qualified parameters for extrapolation review. A compartmental animal model is not mandatory. Keep unresolved project objectives and evidence gaps visible.
Reviewed human-source in vitro binding and metabolism evidence may be used as prediction inputs.
decisions.supersession_scope: Earlier blanket deferral of these human-source in vitro inputs; no extension of permission to target-drug human in vivo PK observations

decisions.text: Allow purpose-specific AUC windows, including AUCtau for steady-state clearance, only when explicitly defined in the proposal. Retain the original primary objective and do not choose an agent default.
decisions.supersession_scope: Replaces the exhaustive AUC0-24h/AUC0-infinity choice restriction in MP001_method_review.20261007.json; preserves proposal-defined windows and pre-reviewed boundary methods.

source.quote: 允许按用途定义，均需 proposal 明示（推荐）

decisions.text: A supported digitized measured group-mean point estimate without reliable uncertainty may enter as a candidate. Human review of use, limitations and uncertainty treatment is required before it counts toward the parameter-specific minimum qualified species. Preserve the gap and do not fabricate uncertainty.

source.quote: 先作为候选，专门审核后才计入（推荐）

decisions.text: Allow same-drug published CL/Vss without original concentration curves into the candidate library. Label LITERATURE_REPORTED, NOT_RECALCULATED and NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED; explain source, definition, method, uncertainty and gaps. Admission is not species qualification. Any downstream use or qualified-species count requires a separate documented review.

publication.note: This record preserves the confirmed human decision. It is not an R-rule artifact, does not alter existing approvals, and is not automatically injected into unrelated projects. Reconcile affected prior rules during formal publication.
